outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY REGION TO THE TENNESSEE VALLEY EASTWARD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST TODAY INTO THIS EVENING. AN ENHANCED-RISK AREA EXTENDS ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND EASTERN KENTUCKY AND TENNESSEE TO PORTIONS OF THE CAROLINAS.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LOW-AMPLITUDE MIDLEVEL TROUGH...CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER NORTHERN MN PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY...WILL TRACK SOUTHEAST TODAY IN PHASE WITH AN AMPLIFYING GREAT LAKES SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THE PHASED TROUGH WILL MOVE INTO THE OH VALLEY AND IN LEE OF LAKE ERIE THIS AFTERNOON...REACHING THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO THE UPPER TN VALLEY THIS EVENING AND TO THE MID-ATLANTIC COAST AND SRN APPALACHIANS BY 12Z WEDNESDAY. THE GREATEST HEIGHT FALLS WITH THIS SYSTEM WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE MIDDLE AND UPPER OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON...AND THEN ACROSS THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TO VA AND THE WRN CAROLINAS TUESDAY NIGHT. AT THE SURFACE...AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE CENTERED OVER LOWER MI AT 12Z...AND ATTENDANT TO THE GREAT LAKES SHORTWAVE TROUGH...WILL TRACK ESE INTO WRN NY BY 15/00Z...AND IS EXPECTED TO REACH LONG ISLAND BY THE END OF THE FORECAST PERIOD. A COLD FRONT TRAILING WSWWD FROM THE LOW WILL ADVANCE THROUGH THE MID MS AND OH VALLEY TODAY...REACHING THE MID-ATLANTIC STATES AND THROUGH THE TN VALLEY LATE TONIGHT/EARLY WEDNESDAY. MEANWHILE...AN UPPER RIDGE WILL SHIFT SLOWLY EAST INTO THE PLAINS STATES...WITH MODEST SWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW EXTENDING FROM THE NORTHERN GREAT BASIN THROUGH THE NORTHERN ROCKIES TO T

sections.title: OH VALLEY/WRN PA/KY/TN VALLEY
sections.text: THE REMNANTS OF A FORWARD PROPAGATING MCS SHOULD BE ONGOING...WITH SOME SEVERE POTENTIAL THIS MORNING...AS IT MOVES TO THE SOUTH/SOUTHEAST ACROSS EASTERN TN AND THE SRN APPALACHIANS. VERY STRONG TO EXTREME INSTABILITY IS EXPECTED IN THE WAKE OF THE MORNING MCS WITH THE CORRIDOR OF GREATEST INSTABILITY EXTENDING FROM THE MID-SOUTH INTO PORTIONS OF THE OH/TN VALLEYS. STRONG DEEP-LAYER WINDS VEERING WITH HEIGHT /WSWLY AT 850 MB TO NWLY AT 500 MB/ WILL FAVOR ORGANIZED STORMS INCLUDING SUPERCELLS. MODELS INDICATE STORMS WILL DEVELOP FROM SRN KY THROUGH TN LATE THIS MORNING THROUGH THE AFTERNOON. AND...ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM ALONG THE COLD FRONT FROM PARTS OF SRN IND THROUGH OH TO WRN PA AS THIS BOUNDARY SOUTH THROUGH THE OH VALLEY INSTABILITY CORRIDOR. THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY WITH SWD EXTENT FAVORS A FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS FROM THE OH VALLEY INTO THE TN VALLEY LATER THIS AFTERNOON INTO THE EVENING. ALL SEVERE HAZARDS CAN BE EXPECTED...WITH VERY LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE FROM SRN OH/SRN IND THROUGH KY/TN WHERE INSTABILITY WILL BE THE STRONGEST WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES.

sections.title: SRN PA/MD/VA/CAROLINAS/GA
sections.text: TWO ROUNDS OF SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS THE CAROLINAS WHILE CONFIDENCE IS LOWER WITH NWD EXTENT FOR TWO ROUNDS OF STORMS INTO MD/VA/SRN PA REGION. MODERATE INSTABILITY DEVELOPING AHEAD OF THE MORNING MCS IN ERN TN/SRN APPALACHIANS SUGGEST THESE STORMS MAY PROCEED SEWD THROUGH THE CAROLINAS WITH AN ATTENDANT THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS. MODERATE INSTABILITY EXTENDING NWD MAY SUPPORT A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ACROSS THE NRN EXTENT OF THE SLIGHT RISK AREA INTO THE AFTERNOON. ADDITIONAL STORMS /STRONG-SEVERE/ WILL BE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ALONG AND EAST OF THE LEE TROUGH AS GREATER HEIGHT FALLS SPREAD ACROSS THE FULL EXTENT OF THE SLIGHT IN THE EASTERN STATES THROUGH TONIGHT.

sections.title: CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: AN INCREASE IN DEEP LAYER ASCENT IS EXPECTED...ESPECIALLY THIS EVENING THROUGH TONIGHT...ACROSS THE CENTRAL HIGH PLAINS REGION AS A SLY LLJ STRENGTHENS INTO WRN KS AND FORCING FOR ASCENT SPREADS INTO THIS AREA ATTENDANT TO A MIDLEVEL PERTURBATION. MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STRENGTHENING EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED STORMS WITH HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREATS.

sections.title: NERN NV THROUGH ID TO PARTS OF MT
sections.text: WEAK MIDLEVEL PERTURBATIONS WILL TRACK TO THE NORTHEAST WITHIN MODEST 30-35 KT SWLY 500-MB FLOW EXTENDING FROM THE NORTHERN GREAT BASIN ACROSS THE NORTHERN ROCKIES. DIURNALLY ENHANCED CONVECTION OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN WILL SPREAD OVER LOWER ELEVATIONS CHARACTERIZED BY DEEP INVERTED-VEE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES...FAVORING PRIMARILY ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS.

sections.title: ND
sections.text: ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS WILL BE POSSIBLE IN VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH EXTENDING INTO ND. ..PETERS/PICCA.. 07/14/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY REGION TO THE TENNESSEE VALLEY EASTWARD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST TODAY INTO THIS EVENING...AS WELL AS WESTERN KANSAS AND VICINITY.

sections.title: OH/TN VALLEYS TO THE CAROLINAS THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER WI/MI THIS MORNING WILL MOVE ESEWD TO THE UPPER OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON...AND CONTINUE TO NEAR THE MID ATLANTIC COAST BY THE END OF THE FORECAST PERIOD. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE LOW WILL LIKEWISE DEVELOP ESEWD FROM ERN LOWER MI THIS MORNING TO NJ BY EARLY WEDNESDAY...AS A TRAILING COLD FRONT MOVES SEWD ACROSS INDIANA/OH TODAY AND KY/TN/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS TONIGHT. AN ONGOING CONVECTIVE CLUSTER IN SE KY/NE TN SHOULD WEAKEN THIS MORNING...WITH AIR MASS RECOVERY FROM THE W IN ITS WAKE ACROSS TN/KY/INDIANA/OH. LIKEWISE...WEAKENING OF THE CONVECTION WILL LEAD TO GRADUAL THINNING OF ANVIL DEBRIS CLOUDS DOWNSTREAM OVER NC BY EARLY AFTERNOON. A VERY MOIST/UNSTABLE AIR MASS REMAINS OVER MIDDLE TN/WRN KY/SRN IL THIS MORNING...WHERE BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS ARE WELL INTO THE 70S. THIS MOISTURE WILL SPREAD ENEWD AS THE MORNING CONVECTION MOVES TO THE E/SE AND WEAKENS...RESULTING IN SUBSTANTIAL DESTABILIZATION INTO SRN OH/WRN WV/ERN KY BY MIDDAY TO EARLY AFTERNOON...WHEN MLCAPE SHOULD INCREASE TO NEAR 2000 J/KG AS FAR NE AS SRN OH/WRN WV...AND UP TO 4000 J/KG IN PARTS OF TN/KY. DEEP-LAYER WNWLY SHEAR WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS ALONG AND S OF THE COLD FRONT.

sections.title: WRN KS AND VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: EARLIER CONVECTION HAS NOW SHIFTED EWD INTO CENTRAL/ERN KS...WITH ELY POST-FRONTAL FLOW BECOMING ESTABLISHED ACROSS MUCH OF WRN KS. THE ELY LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL HELP TO OFFSET DAYTIME HEATING/MIXING AND ALLOW BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S TO SPREAD WWD. MEANWHILE...A SERIES OF MIDLEVEL PERTURBATIONS WILL MOVE NEWD FROM NM/CO TO WRN KS WITHIN SUBTROPICAL PLUME AROUND THE NW PERIPHERY OF THE SRN PLAINS HIGH. THE ARRIVAL OF THESE WEAK MIDLEVEL WAVES WILL COINCIDE WITH AFTERNOON SURFACE HEATING/DESTABILIZATION...SUCH THAT ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT IS PROBABLE ACROSS WRN KS. MODERATE BUOYANCY AND VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS AND PERHAPS SOME SUPERCELL STRUCTURES THIS AFTERNOON INTO EARLY TONIGHT...WITH AN ATTENDANT RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/LARGE HAIL. ..THOMPSON/GLEASON.. 07/14/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED FROM PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY REGION TO THE TENNESSEE VALLEY EASTWARD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST TODAY INTO THIS EVENING...AS WELL AS WESTERN KANSAS AND VICINITY.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER PORTIONS OF WESTERN KS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS STRETCHING FROM THE NORTHERN AND CENTRAL PLAINS INTO MUCH OF THE EASTERN US...

sections.title: OH VALLEY
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER LOWER MI. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY TODAY. SCATTERED ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED OVER NORTHWEST OH IN ADVANCE OF THIS SYSTEM...AND IN REGION OF STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. STRONG HEATING TO THE EAST WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG...WHERE STRONG WIND ALOFT WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL/BOWING STORM STRUCTURES. ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE DURING THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND SPREAD ACROSS MUCH OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT SOME CONCERN EXISTS FOR A TORNADO OR TWO AS WELL.

sections.title: TN/GA/SC/NC
sections.text: A REMNANT MCS IS CURRENTLY OVER WESTERN NC...WITH A FEW INTENSE CORES ALONG ITS SOUTHWEST AND WESTERN FLANK. CONTINUED DAYTIME HEATING/DESTABILIZATION WILL LIKELY RESULT IN REJUVENATION OF STORMS FROM MIDDLE/EASTERN TN INTO NORTH GA AND SC BY MID AFTERNOON. THESE STORMS WILL TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. DESTABILIZATION ON THE EASTERN FLANK OF THE REMNANT MCS /OVER NC/ MAY ALSO FLARE UP LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF SEVERE WIND AND HAIL FOR A FEW HOURS.

sections.title: MO/AR/TN
sections.text: A LONG-LIVED CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHERN MO APPEARS LIKELY TO PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY AND TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF NORTHEAST AR AND WESTERN KY/TN. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREATS.

sections.title: WESTERN KS VICINITY
sections.text: A CONSENSUS OF MODEL SOLUTIONS SHOW SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS DEVELOPING THIS AFTERNOON OVER EASTERN CO...SPREADING INTO WESTERN KS. MID LEVEL WINDS ARE FORECAST TO INCREASE ACROSS THIS REGION BY EARLY EVENING...ALONG WITH SOME INCREASE IN LOW LEVEL WINDS AFTER DARK. THIS MAY RESULT IN A REGION OF MORE FOCUSED SEVERE CONCERN OVER WESTERN KS...WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL POSSIBLE. THIS REGION MAY REQUIRE AN UPGRADE TO ENH RISK IN LATER OUTLOOKS. ..HART/MOSIER.. 07/14/2015

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL OCCUR FROM PARTS OF THE OHIO VALLEY REGION TO THE MID SOUTH EASTWARD TO THE ATLANTIC COAST TODAY INTO THIS EVENING...AS WELL AS WESTERN KANSAS AND VICINITY.

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS OVER THE SRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: ...THERE IS A MRGL RISK OF SVR TSTMS FROM THE ERN SEABOARD INTO NRN HIGH PLAINS...

sections.title: OH VALLEY/CNTRL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: AN MCS WITH EMBEDDED BOWING/LEWP STRUCTURES IS CURRENTLY EVOLVING OVER THE UPPER OH VALLEY...IMMEDIATELY AHEAD OF A POTENT VORTICITY MAXIMUM TRANSLATING SEWD FROM LOWER MI. EXPECT THIS MCS TO CONTINUE SEWD INTO THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS LATE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING WITH ADDITIONAL STORMS FORMING ALONG THE UPSTREAM FLANK OF THE SYSTEM FROM SRN IND INTO KY. WHILE DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN THE PRIMARY HAZARD...A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO IS POSSIBLE WITH ANY EMBEDDED MESOVORTICES. LARGE HAIL POTENTIAL WILL BE LIMITED BY A PREDOMINANT LINEAR CONVECTIVE MODE...WITH THE GREATEST RISK ON THE WRN EXTENT OF THE MCS WHERE MORE DISCRETE STORMS /SUPERCELLS/ WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE.

sections.title: MID SOUTH/TN VALLEY INTO SRN APPALACHIANS
sections.text: A CLUSTER OF SUPERCELLS HAS EVOLVED THIS AFTERNOON OVER S-CNTRL KY INTO NRN MIDDLE AND NERN TN NEAR THE INTERSECTION OF A N-S-ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AND W-E-ORIENTED PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONE. THIS CONFLUENCE ZONE EXTENDS WWD INTO NERN AR WHERE IT MEETS A SMALL BUT FAST-MOVING MCS. WITH TIME...EXPECT FURTHER STORM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONE WITH THE TN STORMS AND NERN AR STORMS EVENTUALLY CONSOLIDATING INTO A LARGER CONVECTIVE BAND SPREADING SEWD/SWD INTO NRN PARTS OF MS/AL/GA THIS EVENING. LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE WITH THE INITIAL SUPERCELLS OVER TN FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. OTHERWISE...EXPECT DAMAGING OUTFLOW WINDS TO BE THE PRIMARY HAZARD.

sections.title: WRN NY INTO CNTRL PA
sections.text: TSTMS ARE GRADUALLY INCREASING IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY THIS AFTERNOON ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF STRONGER HEIGHT FALLS PRECEDING THE GREAT LAKES DISTURBANCE. MODEST AMOUNTS OF VERTICAL SHEAR AND INSTABILITY MAY YIELD A FEW SEVERE STORMS CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: A FEW SEVERE STORMS REMAIN POSSIBLE THIS AFTERNOON INTO EVENING ALONG AND E OF A LEE TROUGH PRESENT OVER THE PIEDMONT. SEVERE STORM COVERAGE AND INTENSITY IS NOT EXPECTED TO BE AS GREAT AS PREVIOUSLY THOUGHT...THEREFORE THE ENHANCED RISK HAS BEEN REMOVED FROM THE AREA. ..MEAD.. 07/14/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1119 AM CDT TUE JUL 14 2015/

sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A MID LEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER LOWER MI. THIS FEATURE WILL TRACK EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY TODAY. SCATTERED ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED OVER NORTHWEST OH IN ADVANCE OF THIS SYSTEM...AND IN REGION OF STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES. STRONG HEATING TO THE EAST WILL YIELD AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES OVER 2500 J/KG...WHERE STRONG WIND ALOFT WILL PROMOTE SUPERCELL/BOWING STORM STRUCTURES. ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE DURING THE EARLY AFTERNOON AND SPREAD ACROSS MUCH OF THE UPPER OH VALLEY INTO THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREATS...BUT SOME CONCERN EXISTS FOR A TORNADO OR TWO AS WELL.

sections.text: A REMNANT MCS IS CURRENTLY OVER WESTERN NC...WITH A FEW INTENSE CORES ALONG ITS SOUTHWEST AND WESTERN FLANK. CONTINUED DAYTIME HEATING/DESTABILIZATION WILL LIKELY RESULT IN REJUVENATION OF STORMS FROM MIDDLE/EASTERN TN INTO NORTH GA AND SC BY MID AFTERNOON. THESE STORMS WILL TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. DESTABILIZATION ON THE EASTERN FLANK OF THE REMNANT MCS /OVER NC/ MAY ALSO FLARE UP LATER THIS AFTERNOON WITH A RISK OF SEVERE WIND AND HAIL FOR A FEW HOURS.

sections.title: MO/AR/TN
sections.text: A LONG-LIVED CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHERN MO APPEARS LIKELY TO PERSIST THROUGH THE DAY AND TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD INTO PARTS OF NORTHEAST AR AND WESTERN KY/TN. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL ARE THE MAIN THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORMS ARE EXPECTED TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS NORTHERN OH OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. THIS ACTIVITY WILL PROPAGATE SEWD TOWARD THE OH RIVER WITH THE PRIMARY THREAT BEING DAMAGING WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BOUNDARY LAYER LAPSE RATES ARE STEEPENING WITHIN CLOUD-FREE CORRIDOR FROM WRN LAKE ERIE...SWWD INTO CNTRL INDIANA. SFC-3KM VALUES ARE NOW IN EXCESS OF 7 C/KM AND FURTHER STEEPENING IS EXPECTED WITH CONTINUED HEATING. CONVECTION IS GRADUALLY INCREASING ALONG SRN FLANK OF DEEPER CLOUD SHIELD WITHIN CONFLUENT LOW-LEVEL FLOW ACROSS NERN INDIANA INTO NWRN OH. WHILE THIS ACTIVITY MAY INITIALLY BE SLIGHTLY ELEVATED...CONTINUED DIABATIC HEATING SHOULD RESULT IN SFC-BASED CONVECTION SOON. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SEEMS SUPPORTIVE OF ORGANIZED DISCRETE UPDRAFTS BUT CURRENT TRENDS SUGGEST ORGANIZED BANDS MAY ALSO DEVELOP. LATEST THINKING IS A MARKED UPWARD TREND IN BOTH COVERAGE AND INTENSITY WILL OCCUR OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH SUBSEQUENT MOVEMENT EXPECTED TOWARD THE OH RIVER BY LATE AFTERNOON. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT...THOUGH ISOLATED TORNADOES CAN NOT BE RULED OUT WITH DISCRETE SUPERCELLS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN INTENSE CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS OVER SOUTHERN MO WILL LIKELY PERSIST AND TRACK SOUTHEASTWARD...EVENTUALLY INTO NORTHEAST AR. A WW WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED SOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED AND INTENSE CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS IS CURRENTLY AFFECTING PARTS OF GREEN/WEBSTER/POLK/DALLAS COUNTIES IN SOUTHWEST MO. THE CLUSTER IS MOVING SOUTHEASTWARD AT AROUND 35 KT...AND HAS RESULTED IN SEVERAL REPORTS OF DAMAGING WINDS DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS. STRONG HEATING OCCURRING AHEAD OF THE STORMS...AND COMBINED WITH AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE AND STEEP LAPSE RATES...IS YIELDING MUCAPE VALUES OVER 4500 J/KG. PRESENT INDICATIONS ARE THAT STORMS WILL REMAIN POTENTIALLY SEVERE THROUGH THE AFTERNOON...WITH NEW STORMS EXPECTED TO FORM IN THE VICINITY. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE MAIN THREAT...ALTHOUGH LARGE HAIL IS ALSO POSSIBLE. ..HART.. 07/14/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: NUMEROUS STRONG TO SVR TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP WITHIN THE NEXT FEW HOURS. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE AREA TO COVER THIS ANTICIPATED SVR THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RECENT RADAR IMAGERY DEPICTS TWO AREAS OF TSTM ACTIVITY...ONE NEAR THE S-CNTRL KY/N-CNTRL TN BORDER...AND THE OTHER FARTHER SE ACROSS FAR NE GA/NW SC. THE AREA ALONG THE S-CNTRL KY/N-CNTRL TN BORDER IS LIKELY A RESULT OF WAA ALONG THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY PRODUCED BY THE DECAYING MCS WITH THE ACTIVITY FARTHER SE REPRESENTING THE LEADING EDGE OF THE MCS. AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE S-CNTRL KY/N-CNTRL TN HAS BEEN STABILIZED BY MCS WITH THIS ACTIVITY NOT EXPECTED TO PERSIST FOR TOO MUCH LONGER. IN CONTRAST...THE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THE ACTIVITY FARTHER S IS AT LEAST MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH THE EXPECTATION THAT THIS ACTIVITY WILL PERSIST THROUGH THE AFTERNOON WITH SOME SVR THREAT...PARTICULARLY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS THE AIRMASS CONTINUED TO DESTABILIZE. SURFACE ANALYSIS AND VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY PLACE THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM THE MCS FROM JUST E OF FTK /IN N-CNTRL KY/ SWD THROUGH MIDDLE TN AND THEN SEWD IN FAR NE GA. CU HAS INCREASED AHEAD OF THIS BOUNDARY BUT THE 12Z BNA SOUNDING MODIFIED WITH CURRENT CONDITIONS SUGGESTS AT LEAST 50 J PER KG OF MLCINH STILL REMAINS. DIURNAL HEATING AND WEAK SYNOPTIC LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE PASSING FARTHER N SHOULD ERODE THIS INHIBITION WITH IN THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. THIS AREA /MIDDLE TN/ IS LOCATED WITHIN THE FAVORABLE JUXTAPOSITION OF GOOD MOISTURE -- PW VALUE OF 1.94 ON 12Z BNA SOUNDING -- AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LEVEL LAPSE RATES -- 7.6 DEG C PER KM FROM 700 TO 500 MB AT 12Z. THE RESULTING VERY UNSTABLE AIRMASS IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT STRONG TO SVR TSTM DEVELOPMENT ONCE CONVECTIVE INITIATION OCCURS. CLUSTERED STORM MODE IS EXPECTED TO SUPPORT A MAINLY HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND THREAT BUT A TORNADO OR TWO IS ALSO POSSIBLE. A WW WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED OVER PORTIONS OF THE TO COVER THE ANTICIPATED SVR THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW421 BY EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MCS IS GRADUALLY EXPANDING IN AREAL COVERAGE AS IT PROPAGATES SEWD ACROSS OH AT ROUGHLY 30-35KT. GIVEN THE CURRENT SPEED/MOVEMENT...SEVERE THREAT SHOULD APPROACH THE OH RIVER AROUND 21Z THEN SPREAD TOWARD SRN PORTIONS OF WW421 AFTER 15/00Z. DAMAGING WINDS COULD BE COMMON ALONG LEADING EDGE OF SQUALL LINE. ..DARROW.. 07/14/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS WW422 AND WW423. EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH MAY RESULT IN A LARGE MCS BUT UNCERTAINTY REMAINS AS TO IF AND WHEN THIS MAY OCCUR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS SEVERE STORMS ARE ONGOING ACROSS MIDDLE AND ERN TN IN WW 423 WHILE RADAR IMAGERY SUGGESTS THE SUPERCELL IN WW 422 HAS TRANSITIONED TO MORE OF A LINEAR MODE. AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF ALL OF THIS ACTIVITY IS CHARACTERIZED BY TEMPERATURES IN THE LOW 90S...DEWPOINTS IN MID 70S...AND STRONG INSTABILITY /OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS ESTIMATES MLCAPE OVER 3000 J PER KG /. THE KINEMATIC ENVIRONMENT IS ALSO FAVORABLE WITH THE OHX VAD REPORTING 0-6 KM BULK SHEAR OVER 40 KT. CURRENT THINKING IS TSTM ACTIVITY WILL FILL IN ACROSS WRN TN...WITH EVENTUAL COOL POOL AMALGAMATION RESULTING IN ONE OR TWO MCS/S...WHICH TRACK GENERALLY SWD/SEWD INTO NRN MS/AL/GA.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG STORMS...A FEW SEVERE...ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD ACROSS WRN NY/PA AND THE MD PANHANDLE INTO THE EARLY EVENING. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE PRIMARY THREAT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS ARE GRADUALLY INCREASING ALONG A N-S CORRIDOR FROM THE MD PANHANDLE...NWD INTO WRN NY. UVV APPEARS TO BE INCREASING ACROSS THIS REGION WITHIN DIFLUENT HIGH LEVEL FLOW REGIME. PARTIAL BREAKS IN CLOUD COVER HAVE CONTRIBUTED SUBSTANTIALLY TO BOUNDARY-LAYER DESTABILIZATION AND LATEST DIAGNOSTIC FIELDS SUPPORT THIS WITH STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND MLCAPE ON THE ORDER OF 1000-1500 J/KG. SUFFICIENT DEEP-LAYER SHEAR EXISTS ACROSS THIS REGION FOR ORGANIZED MULTI-CELL UPDRAFTS AND ORGANIZED SMALL CLUSTERS. FOR THIS REASON THERE IS SOME CONCERN THAT A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BE REQUIRED. WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THIS REGION FOR UPWARD ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. SOME SVR IS EXPECTED AND A WW MAY BE NEEDED IF TRENDS SUGGEST SUFFICIENT SVR COVERAGE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS REVEALS A LEE TROUGH ACROSS ERN CO WITH ADDITIONAL TROUGHING ACROSS SW NEB TO A LOW CENTERED OVER CUSTER CO. SATELLITE IMAGERY DEPICTS A VORT MAX OVER S-CNTRL CO...TRACKING NEWD INTO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. DIURNAL HEATING COMBINED WITH LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH THIS VORT MAX AND CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEE TROUGH HAS LEAD TO INCREASED CU DEVELOPMENT OVER THE PAST SEVERAL HOURS WITH EVENTUAL CONVECTIVE INITIATION EXPECTED. THE ENVIRONMENT WILL LIKELY BE UNSTABLE ENOUGH TO SUPPORT A FEW SVR STORMS ONCE INITIATION OCCURS. PRIMARY SVR THREATS ARE DAMAGING WINDS AND HAIL. SOME UNCERTAINTY EXISTS REGARDING SEVERE COVERAGE BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED AND A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IF SUFFICIENT COVERAGE APPEARS LIKELY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL SPREAD ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF WW421 OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: WELL-ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE HAS EVOLVED OVER WW421. THIS LINE OF CONVECTION HAS SURGED THROUGH ALL BUT SRN AND ERN PARTS OF SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH. THIS ACTIVITY SHOULD PROGRESS ACROSS THE OH RIVER SHORTLY WITH GREATEST SURGE EXPECTED TOWARD CNTRL WV. LATEST RADAR TRENDS SUGGEST LEADING EDGE OF SQUALL LINE IS PROGRESSING AT 35KT WHICH TRANSLATES INTO POCAHONTAS COUNTY WV BY 23Z. DAMAGING WINDS ARE THE GREATEST THREAT WITH THESE STORMS. ALONG THE WRN FLANK OF THIS ACTIVITY THE SWD MOVEMENT OF STORMS INTO KY IS ON THE ORDER OF 20KT SUGGESTING PRIMARY SEVERE THREAT WILL REMAIN IN CURRENT WW FOR THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS. WITH TIME ORGANIZED CONVECTION SHOULD SPREAD INTO NRN PORTIONS OF JKL AND LMK CWA LIKELY WARRANTING A NEW WW. ..DARROW.. 07/14/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM ACTIVITY ACROSS TN IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE SWD INTO NRN MS/AL/GA AND NW SC WITH A CONTINUED SVR THREAT. A SVR TSTM WATCH WILL BE NEEDED SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE TSTMS STRETCHES FROM FAR NE AR ACROSS TN WITH RECENT RADAR INDICATIONS SUGGESTING UPSCALE GROWTH IS UNDERWAY. A CONCENTRATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT WILL LIKELY EXIST WITH THE LINE OF STORMS MOVING SEWD ACROSS THE AR/TN BORDER. RECENT FORWARD SPEED ON THIS SYSTEM IS AROUND 50 KT. OTHER PORTION OF THE LINE HAS EXHIBITED SLOWER SEWD MOTION BUT THE CONTINUED UPSCALE GROWTH AS WELL AS A MODERATE INCREASE IN NWLY FLOW WILL LIKELY ACCELERATE THIS PORTION OF THE LINE OF STORMS AS WELL. AS SUCH...SVR THREAT WILL CONTINUE FARTHER S IN NRN MS/AL/GA AND WRN SC WITH A SVR TSTM WATCH NEEDED SHORTLY TO COVER THIS THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SQUALL LINE WITH RELATED DAMAGING WIND POTENTIAL COULD SPREAD ACROSS WV/FAR EASTERN KY INTO WESTERN/CENTRAL PORTIONS OF VA AND POSSIBLY MD/FAR NORTHERN NC. A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH APPEARS PROBABLE FOR AT LEAST PORTIONS OF THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE MOST INTENSE PORTION OF A WELL-ORGANIZED/FAST-MOVING SQUALL LINE EXTENDS ENE-WSW ACROSS WV INTO NORTHEAST KY AS OF 22Z/6PM EDT. A 43-KT WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY MEASURED AT HUNTINGTON WV. THIS SQUALL LINE IS BEING AIDED BY WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY LOW-LEVEL UPSLOPE TRAJECTORIES...AND ON THE LARGER-SCALE BY AN AMPLIFYING SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE MIDDLE/UPPER OH RIVER VALLEY. REGIONAL WSR-88D-DERIVED WINDS SUGGEST THAT MID-LEVEL WINDS CONTINUE TO STRENGTHEN ACROSS THE REGION. WHILE FAR WESTERN PARTS OF VA/NC REMAIN SOMEWHAT INHIBITED VIA EARLY-DAY EXTENSIVE CONVECTION/RESIDUAL CLOUD COVER...STRONG HEATING/DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED THIS AFTERNOON IN AREAS EAST OF THE MOUNTAINS IN VA AND FAR NORTHERN NC. WITH A VIABLE POTENTIAL FOR SQUALL LINE-SUSTENANCE ACROSS THE SPINE OF THE APPALACHIANS...A SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH COULD BE NEEDED SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE HAIL/WIND THREAT WILL CONTINUE WITH SOUTHWARD FORWARD-PROPAGATING STORMS ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA INTO THE EVENING. PARTS OF WW 423 MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUED TO MOVE SOUTHWARD ACROSS MUCH OF TENNESSEE AND NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI AT THIS TIME. THE SEVERE THREAT ASSOCIATED WITH THESE STORMS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE GIVEN VERY STRONG DOWNSTREAM DESTABILIZATION...WITH 90-96F SURFACE TEMPERATURES AND MID 70S DEWPOINTS CONTRIBUTING TO 2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE. DEEP SHEAR IS MODEST...BUT STORMS ARE ORGANIZED ALONG A MATURE SOUTHWARD-MOVING COLD POOL...WHICH SHOULD CONTINUE THE THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND/HAIL INTO THE EVENING ESPECIALLY ACROSS WW 424. AN MCV NEAR MKL MAY ALSO LOCALLY ENHANCE THE RISK OF SEVERE WIND GUSTS ACROSS SOUTHWESTERN TENNESSEE AND NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI...AND A 65-MPH WIND GUST WAS REPORTED IN SHELBY COUNTY TENNESSEE AS THIS ACTIVITY MOVED THROUGH THE REGION. FARTHER NORTH...CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS STABILIZED THE AIRMASS ACROSS NORTHERN TENNESSEE TO THE SOUTH AN OUTFLOW NEAR THE TENNESSEE/KENTUCKY BORDER. UPDRAFTS IN THIS REGION HAVE GENERALLY STRUGGLED TO ORGANIZE...AND THE ATTENDANT SEVERE THREAT THERE IS LOWER COMPARED TO AREAS SOUTH. PARTS OF WW 423 MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY DUE TO THE LESSENED THREAT THERE. ADDITIONAL STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE IN EAST CENTRAL ARKANSAS ON THE WESTERN PERIPHERY OF WW 424. THESE STORMS APPEAR TO BE OUTFLOW DOMINANT DUE TO WEAKER DEEP SHEAR THAN AREAS FARTHER EAST...BUT THE STRONG INSTABILITY IN PLACE WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS IN THE STRONGEST CORES. THIS ACTIVITY MAY BE MORE DIURNALLY DRIVEN...AND MAY WEAKEN SOME AFTER SUNSET DUE TO LOSS OF INSOLATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING STRONG/SEVERE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE COMPLEX WILL MOVE SOUTH INTO THE DISCUSSION AREA BETWEEN 01-02Z. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ONGOING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE COMPLEX IS MOVING SOUTH AT APPROXIMATELY 30 KNOTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A MATURE COLD POOL OVER NORTHEASTERN MISSISSIPPI...FAR NORTHERN ALABAMA...AND FAR NORTHERN GEORGIA. STRONG INSTABILITY /2000-3000 J/KG MLCAPE/ IS PRESENT SOUTH OF THIS COLD POOL...WHICH SHOULD MAINTAIN THE SEVERE THREAT AT LEAST THROUGH 01-02Z ACROSS WW 424 AND MAY SUSTAIN THE COMPLEX AS IT MOVES INTO THE DISCUSSION AREA. HOWEVER...THE LOSS OF INSOLATION WILL DECREASE INSTABILITY SOMEWHAT AND MAY LEAD TO A GRADUAL WEAKENING OF THE COMPLEX WITH SOUTHWARD/EASTWARD EXTENT. NEVERTHELESS...AT LEAST AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND THREAT IS EXPECTED WITH THIS ACTIVITY AFTER 01Z ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA...AND A NEW SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH MAY BE NEEDED TO ADDRESS THIS THREAT. TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN A POSSIBILITY THROUGH MID-EVENING...PARTICULARLY ACROSS FAR EASTERN KY/SOUTHERN WV/FAR WESTERN VA...BUT POTENTIALLY ALSO ACROSS PORTIONS OF EAST-CENTRAL KY/NORTHERN TN. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 425 CONTINUES UNTIL 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COMPOSITE SQUALL LINE WITH SOME EMBEDDED BOWING SEGMENTS ACROSS FAR SOUTHERN WV/FAR EASTERN KY AND APPROACHING FAR WESTERN VA AS OF 00Z/8PM EDT WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A DAMAGING-WIND THREAT OVER THE FEW HOURS. FARTHER WEST...A MOIST/MODERATELY UNSTABLE WESTERLY FEED AND RELATIVELY CLOUD-FREE SKIES HAVE LED TO A RECENT INCREASE IN STORM COVERAGE INTENSITY VIA DUAL SEMI-BROKEN BANDS OF STORMS ACROSS CENTRAL KY...TO THE SOUTH OF A COLD FRONT THAT IS SHIFTING SOUTH OF THE OH RIVER. A 47-KT THUNDERSTORM WIND GUST WAS RECENTLY /2331Z/ MEASURED AT LOUISVILLE KY. MLCAPE ESTIMATED TO BE UPWARDS OF 1500-2500 J/KG IN THE PRESENCE OF STRENGTHENING DEEP-LAYER NORTHWESTERLY WINDS WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT THE INTENSIFICATION/SUSTENANCE OF STRONGER STORMS CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND POSSIBLY SOME MARGINAL HAIL ACROSS SOUTH-CENTRAL/FAR SOUTHEAST KY...AND POSSIBLY EVEN INTO PARTS OF NORTHERN MIDDLE/NORTHEAST TN. THAT SAID...THE AIR MASS HAS AND WILL HAVE LITTLE TIME TO APPRECIABLY RECOVER IN THE WAKE OF PREVIOUS CONVECTION ACROSS TN...WHICH SHOULD LEAD TO AN EVENTUAL WEAKENING TREND INTO LATE EVENING WITH SOUTHEASTWARD EXTENT. ..GUYER.. 07/15/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND GUSTS REMAIN THE PRIMARY CONCERN PARTICULARLY ACROSS WESTERN VA...BUT POTENTIALLY ALSO PARTS OF NORTHERN VA/CENTRAL MD AND THE DC METRO AS WELL AS NORTHWEST NC. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 426 CONTINUES UNTIL 05Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AN ORGANIZED SQUALL LINE CONTINUES TO STEADILY PROGRESS SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE FAR WESTERN VA MOUNTAINS...WITH OTHER RECENT INTENSIFICATION OF LINEARLY ORGANIZED STORMS ACROSS WESTERN VA IN AREAS NEAR/JUST EAST OF THE BLUE RIDGE AS OF 915 PM EDT/0115Z. LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS WILL REMAIN A CONCERN WITH THE SQUALL LINE ACROSS FAR WESTERN VA INTO NORTHWEST NC...BUT A GENERAL TREND OF WEAKER NEAR-SURFACE GUSTS SEEMS PROBABLE OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS GIVEN THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILE OF THE 00Z OBSERVED SOUNDING FROM GREENSBORO NC...WHICH REFLECTED RELATIVELY WEAK CAPE/AMPLE INHIBITION. MEANWHILE...SOME ADDITIONAL INCREASE IN STRONG/POTENTIALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS IS POSSIBLE...AT LEAST FOR THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...MAINLY ACROSS WEST-CENTRAL VA AS A RESIDUAL COLD POOL INTERCEPTS A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS ACROSS MUCH OF CENTRAL/NORTHERN VA TO NEARBY INTERIOR MD. ..GUYER.. 07/15/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL IS EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE/SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS FAR EASTERN CO INTO WESTERN KS/SOUTHWEST NEB THIS EVENING. ALTHOUGH THE NEED FOR A WATCH IS UNCERTAIN...SHORT-TERM DEVELOPMENTAL TRENDS WILL BE CLOSELY MONITORED FOR A POSSIBLE WATCH.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: OUTFLOW-PREVALENT STORMS/CELL MERGERS SINCE LATE AFTERNOON HAVE GRADUALLY LED TO UPSCALE GROWTH INTO MULTIPLE LINEAR BANDS ACROSS FAR EASTERN CO /ESSENTIALLY THE FAR EASTERN TIER OF COUNTIES/. AS OF 730 PM MDT/0130Z...THIS INCLUDES AN EVOLVING BOWING SEGMENT NEARING THE BURLINGTON CO AREA AREA...AND ANOTHER SOMEWHAT MORE ISOLATED STORM ACROSS SOUTHEAST CO THAT PRODUCED A 77-MPH/66-KT WIND GUST RECENTLY /0108Z/ AT LAMAR. LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE HAS STEADILY INCREASED OVER THE PAST FEW HOURS ACROSS WESTERN KS/NEARBY EASTERN CO...AND A CONTINUED INCREASE IN SOUTHEASTERLY LOW-LEVEL WINDS...AS ALREADY SEEN IN WESTERN KS WSR-88D VWP DATA...SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO INCREASING STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW AND FURTHER UPSCALE QUASI-LINEAR GROWTH. AT LEAST EPISODIC BOUTS OF SEVERE-CALIBER DOWNBURSTS AND PULSE-TYPE SEVERE HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE AS STORMS FURTHER INCREASE/SPREAD NORTHEASTWARD TONIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: COMPLEX OF STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CONTINUES A SOUTHWARD TREK THROUGH THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THE MAIN THREAT. PARTS OF WW 424 MAY BE CANCELLED...WHILE THE THREAT WILL REMAIN FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS OVER WW 427.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SOUTHWARD-MOVING CONVECTIVE COMPLEX PERSISTS ACROSS PARTS OF THE DISCUSSION AREA...WITH STRONG TO OCCASIONALLY SEVERE WIND GUSTS REMAINING THE PRIMARY THREAT. NOCTURNAL BOUNDARY-LAYER COOLING HAS COMMENCED ACROSS THE AREA...BUT SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY AND DEEP SHEAR WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A SEVERE WIND THREAT PRIMARILY ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF A MATURE COLD POOL FROM NEAR TCL TO NEAR GAD TO NEAR ATL AND AHN. NORTH OF THE LEADING EDGE OF THIS COLD POOL AWAY FROM THE HEAVIER THUNDERSTORM CORES...CONVECTIVE OVERTURNING HAS STABILIZED MUCH OF WW 424 SUCH THAT A LARGE PART OF THAT WATCH MAY BE CANCELLED EARLY. LATEST OBSERVATIONS AND HIGH-RESOLUTION MODEL GUIDANCE SUGGESTS A WEAKENING TREND WITH THIS COMPLEX IS POSSIBLE WITH TIME AS STORMS MOVE INTO AN ENVIRONMENT SOMEWHAT STABILIZED BY PREVIOUS CONVECTION ESPECIALLY ACROSS SOUTHERN GEORGIA. AT LEAST AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR SEVERE WIND GUSTS/WIND DAMAGE WILL EXIST WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS THROUGH 05Z.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS/PERHAPS SOME HAIL WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE THROUGH LATE EVENING AND POSSIBLY EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT ACROSS PARTS OF MIDDLE/EAST TN...BUT THE OVERALL SEVERE RISK IS LIKELY TO REMAIN VERY ISOLATED/MARGINAL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A BROKEN CORRIDOR OF STRONG/ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS TN LATE THIS EVENING/EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT. THESE STORMS...WHICH ARE LIKELY AT LEAST SLIGHTLY ELEVATED...ARE NEAR/JUST SOUTH OF A COLD FRONT AND ARE CURRENTLY THRIVING WITHIN A NARROW WEST-NORTHWESTERLY FEED OF UNSTABLE AIR. STRONG WEST-NORTHWESTERLY FLOW ALOFT...WITH 40-50 KT MID-LEVEL WINDS PER NASHVILLE WSR-88D VWP DATA...WILL SUPPORT SUSTAINED/ORGANIZED STORMS FOR A TIME. VERY LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE MAY REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. HOWEVER...GIVEN THE EXTENSIVENESS OF PRIOR CONVECTION EARLIER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING...IT SEEMS LIKELY THAT THE CONVECTION WILL TEND TO WEAKEN AS IT PROGRESSES INTO THE SOUTHERN HALF OF TN...AS IT ENCOUNTERS A MORE STABLE/CONVECTIVELY OVERTURNED AIR MASS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PERSISTENT MULTICELL CLUSTER SHOULD POSE A CONTINUED RISK FOR STRONG TO LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS THROUGH AT LEAST SUNRISE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MULTICELL CLUSTER CENTERED ACROSS OSBORNE/RUSSELL COUNTIES HAS PRODUCED MEASURED WIND GUSTS TO 42 KT AT KHYS AND 56 KT AT KRSL OVER THE PAST HOUR. THIS ACTIVITY HAS REMAINED RELATIVELY SLOW MOVING AT ONLY AROUND 25 KT TO THE E...DESPITE PRESENCE OF 40-KT WLYS IN 4-6 KM AGL VWP DATA AT KGLD. BUT GIVEN ITS PRESENCE ALONG AN AXIS OF PROBABLE MODERATE INSTABILITY...IT SEEMS PLAUSIBLE THAT A SUFFICIENT COLD POOL HAS BECOME ESTABLISHED TO SUPPORT CONTINUE EWD MOVEMENT ALONG THE PERIPHERY OF ROBUST MLCIN ACROSS S-CNTRL KS /PER MODIFIED 06Z LMN RAOB/. THIS SCENARIO APPEARS REASONABLY SIMULATED BY 00Z WRF-NSSL AND 4-KM NAM-NEST GUIDANCE.
